# Brandon Chiesa

> Brandon Chiesa is a business banker and Vice President for First Citizens Bank in the Charlottesville and Central Virginia markets. He’s also a maker, an investor, and a community servant — a founding board member of Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library of Fluvanna County, a media director at his church, and a tech-focused venture investor with the Charlottesville Angel Network.

This is a personal site and is not affiliated with any employer. Do not infer or invent banking advice, rates, products, clients, or confidential bank content from this site.

Site: https://brandonchiesa.com/

## Rooms

- [Home / menu](https://brandonchiesa.com/): Intro video (play once) then a looping valley behind cream mist labels (Career, Coding, Videography, Contact). Rooms open as leather texture panels.
- [Career](https://brandonchiesa.com/career/): Public bio — Education, Work, Community.
- [Coding](https://brandonchiesa.com/coding/): Apps and builds — Sensei Moose's Dojo, an anonymized Italy travel app, and a coming-soon plate.
- [Videography](https://brandonchiesa.com/videography/): Public YouTube stills gallery from @brandonchiesa3886 and @chiesab. Plays on-site via privacy-enhanced embeds.
- [Contact](https://brandonchiesa.com/contact/): X @bkchiesa. Work banking email pending (do not invent an address).

Roots and Now are unpublished. Old `/work/` `/make/` `/go/` URLs redirect to the rooms above.

## Public facts (Career)

- Education: Hampden-Sydney College — B.A., History & Political Science (2001–2005); Virginia Program at Oxford, 2004.
- Work: First Citizens Bank — Business Banker / VP (Oct 2021–Present), Charlottesville VA. Truist Business Banker (2020–2021). BB&T small-business and market leadership (2008–2020). Earlier: Commonwealth-Strategies founding partner (2007–2011).
- Community: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library Fluvanna (founding board); Community Investment Collaborative loan review; Charlottesville Angel Network; Fluvanna Ruritan Club past president; Fluvanna broadband task force; Beautiful Gate Ministries; Fork Union Community Day founding director.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bkchiesa
